name: @veren/startup-autostart-bundle
description: Use when a DSH profile needs the whole Startup Autostart stack (host service, model-facing tools, and Web UI) installed and composed in one step: it is a configuration-only bundle whose patch inserts the three loader rows in dependency order - the host always on, the tools and UI always on - and the member plugins ship as plain dependencies without bundle declarations of their own, so this patch is the stack's only profile layer; skip it when you want only the headless host, or prefer composing these plugins row by row in your own patch.
